# Financial Times: Business News. Empower your ambitions with the Financial Times’ unrivalled, globally focused journalism. Enjoy for free: All podcasts including The Story of Money and FT News Briefing, markets data, our luxury lifestyle magazine How To Spend It and a daily challenge with our crossword puzzles. • Unbiased reporting: Expert comment and analysis on world news, business, politics, economics, finance, companies and more. • Thought-provoking journalism: Explore the arts, real estate, fashion, food, books, technology news and more with a unique FT voice. • Go beyond free access with discounts and offers in the app. IS THE FT FOR YOU? Whether you're an economist analysing global trends, a stockbroker navigating market shifts, a business leader staying ahead of financial news, or a curious mind exploring politics, culture, and the forces shaping our world, the Financial Times offers world-class insights to inspire, inform, and push you further in your ambitions. This app may share these data types with third parties.
